clips.send: Sequence. A computer runs commands one after another, top to bottom — in exactly the order you wrote them. Order matters: put on socks, THEN shoes.

clips.send: Bugs and debugging. A bug is a mistake in a program. Debugging means finding and fixing it: run step by step, check each line, test again. Read the error, find the line, test again.

clips.send: Dont mix up: Give variables clear names: “score” is better than “x”.
clips.text: Dont mix up: Give variables clear names: “score” is better than “x”.

clips.send: Dont mix up: The famous 1947 “bug” was a real moth stuck in a relay of the Harvard Mark II — but programmers had already used the word “bug” for faults before that.
clips.text: Dont mix up: The famous 1947 “bug” was a real moth stuck in a relay of the Harvard Mark II — but programmers had already used the word “bug” for faults before that.

clips.send: Dont mix up: A while loop whose condition never becomes false runs forever — an “infinite loop”.
clips.text: Dont mix up: A while loop whose condition never becomes false runs forever — an “infinite loop”.

clips.send: Condition (if / else). A condition lets the program decide: IF something is true, do this; ELSE do that. Sensors give the program something to decide about. If it’s raining, take an umbrella; else wear sunglasses.
clips.text: Condition (if / else). A condition lets the program decide: IF something is true, do this; ELSE do that. Sensors give the program something to decide about.. If it’s raining, take an umbrella; else wear sunglasses.

clips.send: Dont mix up: if checks ONCE; while keeps checking and repeating.
clips.text: Dont mix up: if checks ONCE; while keeps checking and repeating.

clips.send: Loop. A loop repeats commands. “repeat 4” repeats a fixed number of times; “while” repeats as long as a condition is true. Don’t copy-paste — loop it!
clips.text: Loop. A loop repeats commands. “repeat 4” repeats a fixed number of times; “while” repeats as long as a condition is true.. Don’t copy-paste — loop it!

clips.send: Variable. A variable is a named box that stores a value, like a score or a side length. The value can change while the program runs. A variable is a labelled box.
clips.text: Variable. A variable is a named box that stores a value, like a score or a side length. The value can change while the program runs.. A variable is a labelled box.

clips.send: Dont mix up: Swapping two lines can change everything — right 90 then forward is not the same as forward then right 90.
clips.text: Dont mix up: Swapping two lines can change everything — right 90 then forward is not the same as forward then right 90.

clips.send: 易错点：如果while的条件永远不会变成假，循环就停不下来——这叫“死循环”。
clips.text: 易错点：如果while的条件永远不会变成假，循环就停不下来——这叫“死循环”。

clips.send: 变量。变量是一个有名字的“盒子”，用来存放一个值，比如分数或边长。程序运行时它的值可以改变。变量就是贴了标签的盒子。
clips.text: 变量。变量是一个有名字的“盒子”，用来存放一个值，比如分数或边长。程序运行时它的值可以改变。。变量就是贴了标签的盒子。

clips.send: 易错点：给变量起清楚的名字：“score”比“x”好懂得多。

clips.send: bug与调试。bug就是程序里的错误。调试就是找到并改正它：单步运行、逐行检查、再测试。读错误提示，找到那一行，再测一遍。

clips.send: 易错点：if只检查一次；while会一直检查、一直重复。

clips.send: 条件（if / else）。条件让程序做判断：如果某事成立，就做这个；否则做那个。传感器给程序提供判断的依据。如果下雨就带伞，否则戴墨镜。

clips.send: 顺序。计算机一条接一条、从上到下地执行命令——完全按照你写的顺序。顺序很重要：先穿袜子，再穿鞋。

clips.send: 循环。循环让命令重复执行。“repeat 4”重复固定次数；“while”在条件成立时一直重复。别复制粘贴——用循环！
